welcomeMessage: Welcome to the Flowchart Programming Simulator!

onboarding.step1Content: Let's learn to create programs with flowcharts.
onboarding.step2Content: Use the 'Add Block' button to build your flowchart.
onboarding.step4Content: Execute your flowchart and see it in action.
onboarding.step5Content: You're ready to explore. Happy flowcharting!
